description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for managing app publishing on **Huawei AppGallery Connect**. Integrates directly with Claude Desktop or any MCP-compatible client.

tool_signatures.name: change_phased_release_state
tool_signatures.description: Proceed, roll back, or stop a phased (grey) release.

tool_signatures.name: delete_language_info
tool_signatures.description: Remove a localized store listing from the app draft.

tool_signatures.name: get_download_report_url
tool_signatures.description: Get download URL for app download/install report (CSV or Excel). Max 180-day range.

tool_signatures.name: get_install_failure_report_url
tool_signatures.description: Get download URL for installation failure report (CSV or Excel). Max 180-day range.

tool_signatures.name: get_upload_url
tool_signatures.description: Get a pre-signed upload URL and authCode for an APK/AAB/asset file. Returns uploadUrl, chunkUploadUrl, authCode.

tool_signatures.name: query_app_info
tool_signatures.description: Query app metadata (name, description, category, content rating) from AppGallery Connect. Optionally scope to a release channel with channel_id=2 for open testing.

tool_signatures.name: query_compile_status
tool_signatures.description: Query AAB compilation status for package IDs returned after upload.

tool_signatures.name: set_gms_dependency
tool_signatures.description: Declare whether the app depends on GMS (Google Mobile Services).

tool_signatures.name: submit_app
tool_signatures.description: Submit app for review/release. Supports full, phased, scheduled, channel releases, and open testing (channel_id=2). Save all info first.

tool_signatures.name: submit_app_with_file
tool_signatures.description: Submit app for release using a file hosted on your server (Huawei downloads via HTTPS during review).

tool_signatures.name: update_app_file_info
tool_signatures.description: Attach already-uploaded files to the app draft. Use after get_upload_url + manual upload.

tool_signatures.name: update_app_info
tool_signatures.description: Update app metadata in the AppGallery Connect draft (name, description, category, ratings, support contacts, privacy policy).

tool_signatures.name: update_language_info
tool_signatures.description: Add or update localized store listing (name, description, release notes) for a language.

tool_signatures.name: update_phased_release
tool_signatures.description: Convert phased release to full, or update its schedule/percentage.

tool_signatures.name: update_release_time
tool_signatures.description: Update scheduled release time. Only valid when app is in Releasing state.

tool_signatures.name: upload_app_file
tool_signatures.description: Upload APK/AAB from local disk to AppGallery (get URL → upload, auto-chunked >4 GB → attach to draft).

tool_signatures.name: upload_file
tool_signatures.description: Upload a file to AppGallery using a pre-signed URL (Step 2 of upload flow). Returns fileDestUrl for use in update_app_file_info.
